Local plimsolld on Docker under runc (container tier) with sessions on; the agent sets minimumIsolation "container" because these scenarios are not about the floor. idleTimeoutInSeconds 3 instead of the default 30, so the run suspends after 3 s of real time. 2026-10-07T21:19:59.509Z. Daemon procedures counted by a fetch counter after turn 5: OpenSession 2, SessionRun 7, CloseSession 1. When the harness closed the chat the second sandbox was still open (CloseSession 1): the offline harness runs the agent's run function but not Trigger.dev's task lifecycle hooks. The recorder then called the agent's registered onComplete hook itself, with the run's id, as Trigger.dev's runtime does when a run ends, and it closed that sandbox: CloseSession 2.
